tasks.build: mkdir -p dist && cp src/* dist && deno run -A npm:elm@0.19.2-0 make src/Main.elm --output=dist/index.js
tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run -A npm:serve dist -s -C -S -n
tasks.db:plan: deno eval --env-file=.env "const u = Deno.env.get('DATABASE_URL'); if (!u) throw new Error('Expected DATABASE_URL in .env, received nothing.'); const t = Deno.env.get('TEMP_DATABASE_URL'); const args = ['plan', '--from-dsn', u, '--to-dir', 'schema']; if (t) args.push('--temp-db-dsn', t); Deno.exit((await new Deno.Command('pg-schema-diff', { args, stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }).output()).code)"
tasks.db:apply: deno eval --env-file=.env "const u = Deno.env.get('DATABASE_URL'); if (!u) throw new Error('Expected DATABASE_URL in .env, received nothing.'); Deno.exit((await new Deno.Command('pg-schema-diff', { args: ['apply', '--from-dsn', u, '--to-dir', 'schema'], stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }).output()).code)"
tasks.review: deno run -A npm:elm-review@2.13.5 && deno run -A npm:elm-review@2.13.5 suppress --check-after-tests
